metadata.scenario: A patient who recently had surgery calls to book a physical therapy session for rehabilitation. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I’m calling to schedule a physical therapy session. Hi Betty Lou! I see you’re a regular with us. I hope you’re doing well today. I’m doing okay, thank you. I just had surgery last week, and I need some rehabilitation. I'm glad you reached out. Let’s get you set up with a physical therapist. When would you like to schedule the session? I’d prefer sometime this week, maybe Thursday or Friday if possible. Let me check our schedule. Dr. James Rodriguez is available on both days. Would you prefer morning or afternoon? Morning would be great. Perfect! How about Thursday at 10 AM? Yes, that works for me. Great! I’ll book that appointment for you. Just to confirm, it will be a physical therapy session. Yes, exactly. The pricing for that session will be between $110 and $140, depending on the duration. That’s fine. I just want to focus on my recovery. Absolutely, we’ll take good care of you. Is there anything else you’d like to discuss? Actually, I’ve been having some trouble with my medications since the surgery. Would you like to schedule a medication management session as well? Yes, that would be helpful. Can we do that next week? Of course! I can arrange that when you come in for your physical therapy. Sounds good. So, I have you booked for Thursday at 10 AM with Dr. James Rodriguez for physical therapy. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Betty Lou! We’re here for you. Don’t hesitate to reach out if you need anything else. I won’t. Have a great day! You too! Take care.
